summary: Pattern extraction service analyzes raw messages from activity turns to extract file paths, components modified, common patterns, and complexity indicators.

currentState.description: Basic pattern extraction exists in impulse_learning.py but is limited to normalizing user messages. No dedicated service for analyzing activity turn messages or extracting detailed patterns.

existingComponents.currentBehavior: Extracts normalized pattern from user messages by replacing file paths with {file0}, {file1} placeholders and numbers with {num0}, {num1} placeholders. Only handles basic text normalization.
limitations: Only processes user messages, not activity turn messages
Does not identify common patterns across executions
Limited file path detection (regex-based, may miss some formats)

existingComponents.currentBehavior: Tracks impulse usage by detecting content references in response text. Uses heuristic matching for file paths, memo snippets, and activity IDs.
POST /api/v1/learning-loop/record-turn endpoint receives turn data from opencode and calls insert_mapping_record for processing. Does not expose pattern extraction as a separate service.
